scope: Development qualification of four literal constructions in ten languages, all 90 ordered pairs; not independent linguistic acceptance.

decisions.reading_book: Reading construction selects textual book. Lexical focus excludes the article/classifier, Arabic accusative spelling, Japanese/Korean particles, subject and verbal morphology.
decisions.drinking_water: Drinking construction selects water as a beverage. French partitive article, Arabic definite article, Japanese/Korean object particle and all verbs stay outside focus.
decisions.birthday_party: Birthday modifier selects celebration sense of party. The modifier is required in both phrase indexes but is not part of the replaced noun.
decisions.phone_charger: Telephone modifier selects charging device sense. Possession/linking particles and telephone remain outside the replaced charger noun. Japanese 携帯 is interpreted as telephone in this charger construction.

checks.reading: Required ar/zh/ja/ko forms use readable Latin spelling, not IPA; lexical Arabic case endings are outside the focus.

limitations: Author assessment, not native-speaker or independent assessment.
Literal construction matching does not detect every metaphor, quotation or mistranslated paragraph.
Only the listed spellings and native token windows are eligible; no inferred inflection or unlisted verb form is approved.
These examples are development data and must not be counted as held-out conversational accuracy.
